data.one_liner: Unified reader widget for EPUB, PDF, audiobooks, comics and WebPub
data.what_it_does: Provides a single Dart API to open, display and interact with a wide range of publication formats. It supports text-to-speech, media overlays, annotations, and custom HTTP headers.
use_when: You need an integrated e‑book reader that supports EPUB, PDF, comics and audiobooks in one place
You want TTS and media overlay support without writing platform code
You want a ready‑made widget that handles navigation, highlighting and position restoration
avoid_when: You only need to display PDFs or a single format
You need a lightweight solution without the extra dependencies
data.setup_notes: Add native setup for iOS/Android (info.plist, AndroidManifest.xml) and enable web support in pubspec. No build_runner needed.
